newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD WOMEN'S 10 KMS WALK CHAMPION SIDOTI.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD WOMEN'S 10 KMS WALK CHAMPION SIDOTI.

text.p: Profile of Annarita Sidtoi, who won the world women's 10 kms walk title on Thursday.
Born July 25, 1969. Gioiosa Marea, Messina, Italy.
Diminutive natural sciences student, who won the European title in Split in 1990.
Finished second in the 1994 Helinski European championships but her previous best performance in a global championships has been seventh in the 1992 Barcelona Olympics.
